Start with first elements. Then for each i from 0 to n-1: for each subsequent element in iterables[i], update current[i] and yield tuple(current). That's it.

Implement accordingly. Also handle errors: if any iterable empty raise ValueError.

Also test for zero iterables: return empty tuple.
